steps.action: C32 prerequisite: four Entities built by clearly-labelled API fixtures
steps.actual: API fixtures created "Rev C32 main LRXRCLO", "Rev C32 owned LRXRCLO", "Rev C32 other owner LRXRCLO" and "Rev C32 cycle tail LRXRCLO"; every reader step below is performed in the browser

steps.action: C32 guide steps 1-3: Add officer saves the name, Role, Appointed on and Linked user
steps.actual: Add officer saved "Rev Ines Duarte LRXRCLO" as Director appointed 2022-05-09 with Ravi Menon as the linked user; all four survived a reload

steps.action: C32 guide step 4: an Officer row's text saves when focus leaves the field
steps.actual: Typing "Rev Ines Duarte LRXRCLO Jr" into the Officer name and clicking the Officers heading to move focus away saved it with no further confirmation; the same transition restored "Rev Ines Duarte LRXRCLO"

steps.action: C32 negative: a resignation before the appointment is refused and leaves the row unchanged
steps.actual: Resigned on 2021-01-01 against an appointment of 2022-05-09 was refused with "The resignation date cannot be before the appointment date." shown beside the card; after a reload the appointment was still 2022-05-09 and no resignation was stored

steps.action: C32 guide step 5: a valid resignation moves the Officer behind Show former
steps.actual: Resigned on 2024-08-31 saved when focus left the field and took the Officer out of the current list; Show former brought the row back carrying that resignation date

steps.action: C32 guide note: Remove deletes the Officer entry
steps.actual: "Remove Rev Ines Duarte LRXRCLO" deleted the Officer entry; it was absent even with Show former turned on

steps.action: C32 guide steps 1-3: Add registration saves its facts and leaves Formation jurisdiction alone
steps.actual: Add registration saved Nordvik LRXRCLO / NV-LRXRCLO / Nordvik Agents AS with Status Lapsed, and the Entity's own Formation jurisdiction stayed "Rev C32 LRXRCLO"

steps.action: C32 guide step 3: a Registration Status selection saves immediately
steps.actual: Choosing Withdrawn saved without any further confirmation and survived a reload

steps.action: C32 guide note: removing a Registration detaches its Obligation without deleting it
steps.actual: Removing Nordvik LRXRCLO left the Obligation "Rev C32 licence renewal LRXRCLO" on the Entity with its Registration cleared to "None", so the link was detached rather than the Obligation deleted

steps.action: C32 guide steps 1-4: Add Holding records the ownership on both Entities
steps.actual: "This Entity owns Rev C32 owned LRXRCLO" at 60% listed Rev C32 owned LRXRCLO under Rev C32 main LRXRCLO's Owned Entities and listed Rev C32 main LRXRCLO at 60% under Rev C32 owned LRXRCLO's Owners

steps.action: C32 negative: an Entity cannot own itself, repeat a Holding, or close an ownership loop
steps.actual: the Entity is not offered in its own Holding picker (the list answered []), so it cannot be chosen as its own owner; an Entity already in a Holding with this one is left out of the picker (the list answered []), so the same directional Holding cannot be repeated; closing the loop through Rev C32 owned LRXRCLO refused with "This holding would create a loop: Rev C32 cycle tail LRXRCLO → Rev C32 main LRXRCLO → Rev C32 owned LRXRCLO → Rev C32 cycle tail LRXRCLO."; afterwards the one recorded Holding was still the only one

steps.action: C32 guide note: a total over 100% warns but still saves, and a percentage corrects on blur
steps.actual: Two owners at 60% each both saved and produced the "Ownership totals 120%" warning; correcting one row to 30% and moving focus away persisted and cleared the warning

steps.action: C32 guide step 5: Remove takes the Holding away and keeps both Entities
steps.actual: "Remove Rev C32 owned LRXRCLO" deleted only the Holding; both "Rev C32 main LRXRCLO" and "Rev C32 owned LRXRCLO" still opened as their own records

steps.action: C32 guide section: a new Entity's Documents start empty, with no pre-created statutory folders
steps.actual: The Entity's Documents tab opened on "No documents on this Entity yet." with New folder and Upload offered and no pre-created statutory folders

steps.action: C32 required action: upload Entity-owned paper and confirm it is owned by this Entity
steps.actual: Upload filed the fictional "rev-c32-certificate.txt" as Executed on Rev C32 main LRXRCLO at Version v1; it did not appear on Rev C32 other owner LRXRCLO, so the Document stayed owned by the Entity it was filed against

steps.action: C32 guide steps 1-3: Archive marks the Entity and hides it from the ordinary registry
steps.actual: Archive saved at once, put an Archived mark on the record with "This entity is archived. Restore it to edit.", disabled its Legal name and withdrew Add officer, and took the Entity out of the ordinary registry results

steps.action: C32 guide steps 2-3: Show archived finds it and Restore returns its controls, Document and Obligation
steps.actual: Show archived brought "Rev C32 main LRXRCLO" back into the registry; Restore returned its editing controls, its Obligation "Rev C32 licence renewal LRXRCLO" was still recorded, and its Document "rev-c32-certificate.txt" was still filed at v1
